title: Review of c49's thermals controls (fresh seed 21): the 1.5x resolution result replicates (65 persistent splits, generation 9, 30 of 51 dividing caps travel 3 sqrt(area) between birth and division) and the local fuel cut kills the target cap within 2-10 t (fed twin keeps 1-2 in the strip), but caps outside the strip fall to 0.63x in the cut arm against 0.84x in the fed twin, so the cut is less local than reported; Weak
summary: Re-ran c49's world.py at 1.5x resolution (dx 2/3, 192^2, same physical box, seed 21, T=600) with divmove.py, and cut.py on seed 21 (branch at t=400: fed twin vs fuel held at 0 in a vertical strip on the cap with the widest clearance, here clearance 5 px among 33 caps). Resolution: 65 persistent splits, generation 9, merge/split 0.04; dividing caps travelling >= 3 sqrt(area) between their own birth and division 30 of 51 (17 of 51 in long axes), 42 of 51 upward (c49: 66/75 splits, 34/48 and 33/51). Cut: caps inside the strip 1 -> 0 by t=410 and none to t=480, fed twin 1-2 inside. Outside the strip: cut arm 32 -> 20 (0.63x) vs fed 32 -> 27 (0.84x) at t=480; cut_s21.png shows the fuel-free band widening beyond the strip as the fast-diffusing fuel drains into it, so caps near the strip also lose supply. The long run (T=2000) was not re-run.

observations.E: cut_s21.json: target strip 1 -> 0 caps by t=410 (fed 1-2); outside 0.63x (cut) vs 0.84x (fed) at t=480
observations.M: rerun/res15_seed21/divmove.json: 30 of 51 dividing caps >= 3 sqrt(area) at 1.5x resolution
observations.D: rerun/res15_seed21/metrics.json: 65 persistent splits, generation 9 at 1.5x resolution

seeds_run.result: resolution pass; cut kills the target but also lowers caps outside the strip (0.63x vs 0.84x)

controls_run.E: cut_s21 (local strip cut with the fed twin branched at t=400)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the cut's target had only 5 px clearance among 33 caps, which may explain part of the outside loss; T=2000 not re-run. E remains by construction (heat is made only by burning).
